resolution: All explicit baseline findings have an implemented response; exact test outcomes are recorded in validation/results.json and any subsequent rerun logs.

findings.original_observation: Duration and loop-end numeric editors expose text editing but no visible +/- or mouse adjustment affordance.
findings.response: Shared visible −/+ controls for tempo, clip timing and loop endpoints; exact duration presets; live trim end/duration feedback; Properties shows musical position and elapsed seconds without changing precision.

findings.original_observation: Tool mode persists from piano-roll note drawing into arranger unexpectedly.
findings.response: Arranger, MIDI and audio workspaces retain their own edit tools through navigation.

findings.original_observation: Clicking a selected clip retains a multiple-clip selection, so Fit selection zoomed all clips when one was intended.
findings.response: Plain Select click collapses selection on release; dragging preserves the selected group. Group context menus show the selection count.

findings.original_observation: Precise snap timing is difficult when a beat occupies only a few pixels; the initial 30-second trim landed at30.134s.
findings.response: Live trim feedback, visible zoom and Fit selection, exact range durations, and a meter-aware 1 bar snap choice.

findings.original_observation: Tool selection rearranges controls and causes misclicks
findings.response: Shared note controls retain their positions between Select/Pencil and when selection changes.

findings.original_observation: Tempo has no discoverable mouse adjustment
findings.response: Shared visible −/+ controls for tempo, clip timing and loop endpoints; exact duration presets; live trim end/duration feedback; Properties shows musical position and elapsed seconds without changing precision.

findings.original_observation: Exact duration requires export-dialog checking and tiny edge corrections
findings.response: Live trim feedback, visible zoom and Fit selection, exact range durations, and a meter-aware 1 bar snap choice.

findings.original_observation: Zoom out was not discoverable
findings.response: Visible −/+ and Fit selection beside Fit in all three music editors, with existing viewport limits and Previous view.

findings.original_observation: Preview failure is easy to confuse with plugin failure
findings.response: Without preview and Preview image / Unavailable distinguish an optional image from instrument loading and preserve diagnostic details/retry.

findings.original_observation: Piano-roll keys label only C octaves. In-between note pitches require counting semitone rows.
findings.response: Hovering the keyboard or piano row reveals pitch names without filling the grid with permanent text.

findings.original_observation: First mouse trim landed at 8.75 beats instead of 8 on the last audio clip. Properties showed beats only; dragging the numeric duration text selected text rather than adjusting it.
findings.response: Shared visible −/+ controls for tempo, clip timing and loop endpoints; exact duration presets; live trim end/duration feedback; Properties shows musical position and elapsed seconds without changing precision.

findings.original_observation: Export says Arrangement 0:30.000 with Include effect tails enabled by default, but the exported file measured 30.2 seconds. Unchecking tails gave exact 30.0 seconds.
findings.response: Export labels the arrangement duration plus tails explicitly; disabling tails gives the exact arrangement length.

findings.original_observation: After MIDI export the persistent status still read Exported Midnight circuit.wav, leaving no visible confirmation of the MIDI action. The MIDI file did exist.
findings.response: Export status owns the successful MIDI filename and path; MIDI waits for pending WAV export and failures preserve the previous success and retry.

findings.original_observation: WAV export presents no visible sample-rate or bit-depth options.
findings.response: Export displays the actual sample rate, stereo channels and 32-bit float encoding.

findings.original_observation: Toolbar controls jump when changing edit tools
findings.response: Shared note controls retain their positions between Select/Pencil and when selection changes.

findings.original_observation: Exact mouse-only duration is hard to inspect and adjust
findings.response: Shared visible −/+ controls for tempo, clip timing and loop endpoints; exact duration presets; live trim end/duration feedback; Properties shows musical position and elapsed seconds without changing precision.

findings.original_observation: Loop and timeline units need clearer relationship
findings.response: Loop region shows musical and elapsed timing with a full hover label; Range includes Loop arrangement and endpoint steps; clip Properties and project title reveal elapsed duration before export.

findings.original_observation: Mixer displays excessive decimal precision
findings.response: Idle gain is one decimal; focused entry retains full f32 dB precision. Viewing, cancelling and unchanged blur do not change stored gain or history.

findings.original_observation: Master meter was silent while track meters moved
findings.response: Reproduced with actual output PCM and zero underruns. Master now uses coherent stereo peaks and the same 24 dB/s release as channel meters; output PCM is unchanged and pause/seek clear stale peaks.

findings.original_observation: Exact numeric properties are keyboard dependent
findings.response: Shared visible −/+ controls for tempo, clip timing and loop endpoints; exact duration presets; live trim end/duration feedback; Properties shows musical position and elapsed seconds without changing precision.

findings.original_observation: Tool switching reflows the note toolbar
findings.response: Shared note controls retain their positions between Select/Pencil and when selection changes.

findings.original_observation: Active tools change across editors
findings.response: Arranger, MIDI and audio workspaces retain their own edit tools through navigation.

findings.original_observation: VST preview failure looks like instrument failure
findings.response: Without preview and Preview image / Unavailable distinguish an optional image from instrument loading and preserve diagnostic details/retry.

findings.original_observation: Mouse-only project naming lacks an option
findings.response: On-demand shared name keyboard for project, clip and track names, with selection/backspace/clear/shift and explicit Apply/Cancel. Unsaved project names supply Save/WAV/MIDI defaults.

findings.original_observation: Musical timing uses multiple units without conversion in properties
findings.response: Loop region shows musical and elapsed timing with a full hover label; Range includes Loop arrangement and endpoint steps; clip Properties and project title reveal elapsed duration before export.
